Real use cases

General-purpose assistant One app for writing, brainstorming, coding, and image generation.

Everyday research and Q&A Fast answers across nearly any topic.

Bottom line

ChatGPT's strength is breadth: one subscription covers chat, image generation, and a large plugin ecosystem most rivals can't match. On long, nuanced documents it can feel slightly less careful than Claude, and the free tier's usage caps are tighter than some competitors', but as an all-purpose daily driver it's hard to beat.

Frequently asked questions

Is ChatGPT free?

Yes, with a free tier that has tighter usage limits than paid plans.

Does ChatGPT generate images?

Yes, via DALL·E 3 integration.

What's the ChatGPT Plus price?

Paid plans start at roughly $20/mo — check OpenAI's site for current pricing.

Does ChatGPT have plugins?

Yes, one of the widest third-party plugin and integration ecosystems available.

Is ChatGPT good for coding?

Yes, though GitHub Copilot's IDE integration is more convenient for day-to-day coding.

When was ChatGPT last tested by Luvent?

We last tested it on 2026-07-25.
